executiveSummary: OT/ICS risk is elevated this period due to: (1) multiple critical flaws in widely deployed industrial gateways and controllers, (2) active nation-state and ransomware activity impacting critical sectors, and (3) a concurrent surge in exploitation of web/perimeter vulnerabilities that can enable pivots toward OT networks. Two separate CISA weekly bulletins highlight unauthenticated RCE and management bypass in Advantech EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS gateways and publicly exploitable command injection in Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways, presenting immediate risk to IIoT uplinks and field connectivity. View Bulletin View Bulletin Hitachi Energy advisories disclose high-severity issues in CoreTec OT products and TRO600 industrial routers that can expose credentials, bypass network access controls, and lead to full device takeover if unpatched. Security Advisory Security Advisory Multi-agency guidance warns of active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs with AI-generated scripts and PRC-linked campaigns blending botnets, VPN infrastructure, and living-off-the-land techniques across critical infrastructure. Advisory Advisory Ransomware pressure remains significant: a joint advisory details "SafePay" operations affecting 600+ victims with IT-to-OT adjacency via edge device exploits, credential abuse, and backup destruction tactics. #StopRansomware Advisory At the web/perimeter layer, CISA added multiple families to the KEV catalog (PHP, Ivanti, GitLab/Cisco ASA-FTD, ESXi/Linux, Adobe/Magento, Brotli), with active mass scanning and exploit attempts that increase initial-access risk to operator portals and DMZ systems. CISA KEV JPCERT Alert

items: PRC-linked campaigns blend botnets, VPN infrastructure, and LOTL against critical infrastructure. Advisory
Active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs with AI-generated scripts for S7comm/snap7 probing and PUT/GET manipulation. Advisory
"Vapor Panda" uses AI-powered ARTEX framework in large-scale intrusion campaigns across government, telecom, and U.S. defense-adjacent sectors. View Article
Confirmed compromise of a U.S. government-affiliated environment via chained PHP2/edge-device exploits underscores perimeter risk. View Article
SafePay ransomware remains active across sectors; guidance includes IOCs and mitigation playbooks. #StopRansomware

relevance: Industrial connectivity components (Advantech EKI/WISE, Hitachi CoreTec/TRO600) present the most immediate operational risk due to unauthenticated RCE, privilege escalation, and access-control bypass on devices that bridge field networks and enterprise systems. Concurrently, multi-agency advisories outline active targeting of PLCs and persistent PRC-linked campaigns. Web/perimeter exploitation (PHP, Ivanti, GitLab/Cisco, ESXi/Linux, WordPress) increases the probability of IT-to-OT pivots where segmentation is weak.

items: PHP RCEs (CVE-2026-109618/109619) - widely exploited; immediate patching and webshell hunting recommended. JPCERT Krebs
Ivanti Connect Secure - two KEV entries; prioritize remediation and compromise assessment. CISA KEV
GitLab CE/EE and Cisco ASA/FTD - KEV; monitor for crashes and anomalous admin activity. CISA KEV
ESXi/Linux kernel - KEV; apply vendor patches and hunt for persistence on hypervisors. CISA KEV
Brotli library - memory corruption; identify embedded dependencies and patch. JPCERT
WordPress Core RCE - active scanning for staging paths during updates. View Article
TeamViewer pre-15.83 - host-to-viewer overflow and code-smuggling risks; update to 15.83+. Security Advisory Supporting Report
Siemens Mendix SAML module - assertion replay in IdP-initiated SSO; update and disable IdP-initiated flows. ICS Advisory
Intelbras cameras - unauthenticated firmware upgrade DoS; apply fixed firmware. View Article
Windows Patch Tuesday - actively exploited Shell SFB; prioritize OT-adjacent HMIs and EWS. Krebs

descriptions: Initial access via public-facing application exploits (T1190) and valid accounts (T1078) from VPN/edge device compromise
Credential access and abuse: password spraying (T1110), token theft/abuse in cloud (T1528)
Web shells and persistence on servers (T1505.003)
PLC/ICS manipulation attempts over S7comm (TA0103/ICS-specific) with AI-generated scripts

outlook72h: Expect opportunistic mass exploitation against PHP targets and WordPress upgrade paths; prioritize Internet-exposed triage. Increased probing of OT gateways on management ports and OPC UA; monitor for anonymous session spikes and device resets. Continued credential-based intrusion attempts and VPN edge targeting (Ivanti/ASA-FTD) in tandem with password spraying. Potential follow-on exploitation against Energy and Water/Wastewater operators where segmentation is weak.
